Description: Faceted product listing, search, and product detail with variants.
Persistent cart, coupons, GST tax, checkout flow, and provider-agnostic payment with a test mock.
Order history with simulated tracking, GST invoice PDF, cancellation and returns.
Registration and login, and the staff back-office: catalogue CMS, order management, promotions and RBAC.
As a shopper I want to combine filters (category, brand, price, rating) on the listing page and see the result count for each option.
As a shopper I want autocomplete as I type, with tolerance for small spelling mistakes. In-app search for launch.

Summary: Product detail page with SKU variants
Description: As a shopper I want a product page with an image, description, tax-inclusive price, and a variant selector where each variant is its own SKU; add-to-cart resolves to a specific SKU.
As a shopper I want to add, update the quantity of, and remove cart items, with the cart persisting across sessions for a logged-in customer.
As a shopper I want a short checkout: delivery address, delivery method, review with totals and taxes, payment, then confirmation. Show all charges before payment.
As a shopper I want to enter a promo code at checkout and see the discount reflected in the totals before I pay.

Summary: Payment via provider-agnostic module + test mock
Description: As the platform I want payments handled through one payment interface with a built-in test-mode mock (success/failure/pending), so checkout works end-to-end with no live keys. An order is confirmed only when payment succeeds; on failure the customer keeps their cart and can retry.
As the platform I want to compute GST on the order and show tax-inclusive prices, and generate a downloadable GST tax-invoice PDF for each order.
As a customer I want a list of my orders and an order-detail page with a status timeline (Confirmed, Packed, Shipped, Delivered) using simulated tracking.

Summary: Cancel order and request a return
Description: As a customer I want to cancel an order before it ships (releasing reserved stock and recording a refund if prepaid), and to request a return for eligible items within the return window.

Summary: Register, log in, and reset password
Description: As a customer I want to register for an account with my email and a password. Separately, I want to log in and log out securely. And separately, I want to reset a forgotten password via an emailed link that expires.
As a merchandiser I want to create, edit, publish and unpublish products, variants and prices myself, without raising an engineering ticket.
As staff I want to view orders and advance their status in one place, with role-based access so each team sees only what it should and staff actions are audit-logged.
As a merchandiser I want to create promo codes with a percentage or flat discount, an expiry date and a usage limit.
